findings.finding: evoke is a merger-arbitrage stock: the offer is fixed at 0.537 Intralot shares (or 52p cash, capped and pro-rated). The stock sits at about a 19% discount to the offer's ~50.6-51.3p value, completion is guided only to 'Q4 2026 or Q1 2027', and some regulatory conditions are still outstanding. So the one release line that can move the price is a timetable or approvals statement, and with the spread this wide a positive restatement (approvals received, sanction date) carries more upside than a slip carries downside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the offer: H1 interims (which restated the timetable) +0.22% on 2026-08-12; Q3 notice -0.47% on 2026-10-16 (sealed baseline history). The shares rose about 12% to 45p on the offer announcement on 2026-06-05 (AJ Bell report).
findings.why_not_priced: A timetable restatement in the 07:00 RNS is new information the price cannot already hold. What is priced is the spread: 41.5p against ~50.6p share value. If the market expected a firm sanction date, the spread would already have compressed toward the cash level; it has instead widened, from 45p at announcement and 43.1p on 5 October to 41.5p, while Intralot sat flat at EUR1.12-1.13. Part of that, about 3%, is GBP strength (GBPEUR 1.157 implied at announcement against 1.1935 now).
findings.independence: The Jersey CRA formally opened its review on 2026-09-14 (Northeast Times, https://northeasttimes.com/?p=163672). It is a separate source and shows at least one approval still pending. It does not say which way the release will go.

findings.finding: Entain's Q3 2026 trading update (15 Oct) reported UK&I online NGR +14% (gaming +17%, sports +3%) 'ahead of expectations', but also customer-friendly football results in August-September (a 1-2pp sports margin headwind). That points to a decent William Hill UK online quarter with a sports-margin drag.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 trading update +2.16% (2025-10-28), before the offer. Since the offer, operating prints have moved the stock by less than 0.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: Entain is a peer, not evoke's own number, and evoke's Q3 revenue has not been published. But under a fixed exchange ratio, operating numbers only matter through perceived break risk, so even an unpriced beat transmits weakly. That is why the size is near zero.

findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the disclosures are public and the spread has already widened. The remaining point is that further supply from holders who will not take Athens-listed paper (the release requires a DSS account) caps any upside from the release. Not a negative reading of the quarter.
